## Verdict

wrong

## Bearer

NavigationModule.provideWatchRaceNavigator — app-wear/src/main/java/com/mgilli/app_wear/di/NavigationModule.kt

## Trigger

Hilt injecting MainActivity's `@Inject lateinit var navigator`, in `onCreate` — observed

## Today

`provideWatchRaceNavigator` calls `runBlocking { profileRepository.observe().first() }` to
read `lastSyncSuccessAt` and derive `profileAlreadySynced`, then passes that `Boolean` to
`WatchRaceNavigator`'s primary constructor. Hilt resolves this `@Provides` while injecting
`MainActivity`'s fields, inside `onCreate`, on the main thread — so every cold start blocks
the thread that must draw the first frame until the profile row has been read from Room.
`WatchRaceNavigator` bakes `profileAlreadySynced` into `mutableCurrent` the first time
`current` is read (`by lazy`), using the plain `Boolean` it was given at construction; there
is no path for a value to arrive after construction. The comment on both `NavigationModule`
and `WatchRaceNavigator` documents this as a deliberate "one-shot synchronous read" — the
same pattern the file says `RaceRecordingRepositoryImpl` also relies on for its own
synchronous profile read.

## Expected

`provideWatchRaceNavigator` returns `WatchRaceNavigator` without blocking on
`profileRepository.observe().first()`. The navigator learns `profileAlreadySynced` either
from a suspension it performs itself once something starts collecting it, or from a value it
is given once an asynchronous read elsewhere has completed — never by having the thread that
constructs it block on the database. Because `WatchRaceNavigator`'s `mutableCurrent` is
computed once, eagerly, from the `Boolean` given at construction, giving it the value later
requires `WatchRaceNavigator` to accept `profileAlreadySynced` as something re-evaluated after
construction (a supplier re-invoked at each access, the way `sensorPermissionGranted` already
is, or an explicit update entry point comparable to `ActivityBoundPermissionHost.bind()`) —
today's `Boolean` constructor parameter cannot carry a value that is not yet known when
`provideWatchRaceNavigator` returns.
